comment: Moldova is outside the common system of VAT: Directive 2006/112/EC binds
the Member States of the European Union, and Moldova, a candidate for
accession since June 2022, is not one of them. It levies a value added tax
of its own, TVA, under Titlul III of the Codul fiscal (Legea nr. 1163-XIII
din 24 aprilie 1997), articles 93-118, at a standard rate of 20% (art. 96
lit. a)). `vat_prefix` is null: a Moldovan taxpayer is identified by the
cod fiscal (IDNO for a legal person, IDNP for a natural one) the State Tax
Service assigns, which carries no ISO country prefix comparable to an EU
territories.name: Moldova
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries, candidate for accession or not. Moldova levies a value added tax of its own, TVA, under Titlul III of the Codul fiscal (Legea nr. 1163-XIII din 24 aprilie 1997), articles 93-118, which sets the rates at art. 96.
